constant.name: Speed of Light in Vacuum
constant.Description: Th e fundamental physical constant representing the propagation speed of all electromagnetic waves through a vacuum.

constant.name: Vacuum permittivity
constant.Description: An electric constant describing the capability of a vacuum to permit electric field lines; relates electric charge to electric fields.

constant.name: Vacuum permeability
constant.Description: * * A magnetic constant describing the ability of a vacuum to support magnetic field formation; relates magnetic flux density to electric current.
